summary: A1 revised Explore review approved. All three blocking findings from 002 are resolved: the ESM package and NodeNext import contract are explicit, @types/node is a direct Node 22 devDependency, and typecheck covers both production and test TypeScript through tsconfig.test.json. The scope remains limited to the A1 runtime foundation. One non-blocking documentation inconsistency is recorded for Proposal cleanup.

nonBlockingFindings.title: Node typings explanation does not match the displayed tsconfig
nonBlockingFindings.evidence: The explanatory text says types: [node] is explicitly configured, but the displayed production tsconfig does not contain a types field. The direct @types/node devDependency is sufficient because TypeScript includes visible @types packages by default when types is omitted.
nonBlockingFindings.impact: No functional or boundary impact; the stated dependency keeps Node API and node:test declarations available. Leaving the mismatch can confuse implementation review.
nonBlockingFindings.recommendation: During propose, either add types: [node] to the displayed tsconfig or revise the explanation to describe the default visible-types behavior.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Explore now requires package.json type=module, engines.node >=22.0.0, and emitted .js relative import specifiers for NodeNext source.
Explore now declares @types/node ^22.0.0 as a direct devDependency.
Explore now defines tsconfig.test.json, typechecks both projects, and quotes the Node test glob.
